summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist as specified. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with private helpers _resolve_path and _resolve_field, exported it via an explicit import in monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and wrote tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Line lengths are under 120 in all touched Python files. Tests were not run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; a non-mapping top-level JSON value is treated as a missing key; malformed JSON surfaces as json.JSONDecodeError, a ValueError subclass.
